text_block_list.text: Recording claw machine result as a success.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I was able to acquire very useful knowledge from your determined facial expressions and hand movements, among other things.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I believe this will adequately aid in "small talk." Thank you, Master.
